tables.notes: One row per account, keyed and owned by user_id (default auth.uid()). Fixtures must be written for the disposable E2E accounts only and removed afterwards (delete by user_id).

Owner-scoped pledge rows. amount_naira is a constrained positive numeric field, so every disposable fixture must supply an explicit valid value (whole naira, >= 1). Rows must be created through the UI/authenticated client for the disposable E2E accounts and deleted afterwards by id or reference.
